summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.76/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.76 a gallon across Wisconsin as of July 23, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 12¢ higher than a week ago, 12¢ higher than a month ago, and 91¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.46) and the highest in Superior ($3.97).
